figures.finding: The film agency ACAU's Fondo de Fomento (Law 18.284) set 2023 competitive ceilings of $24.95 million for production, $3.34 million for development and $6 million for minority co-productions, in Uruguayan pesos.

figures.finding: Under Decree 153/2026 (promulgated 3 July 2026), companies producing international audiovisual works or Uruguayan features in Uruguay get a tax credit of 30% of admitted spend in the country, paid as credit certificates valid 36 months.

sources.said: obtendrán un crédito fiscal por el 30% (treinta por ciento) de los gastos admitidos erogados en el territorio de la República

figures.finding: The Programa Uruguay Audiovisual's 2024 cash rebate for international productions repaid 25% for projects of USD 300,000 to 3 million (capped at USD 750,000) and 20% above USD 3 million (capped at USD 1 million), plus 5% more on a feature with a Uruguayan director or lead writer.

sources.said: Para largometrajes, será el equivalente al 5% del reembolso correspondiente.

figures.finding: In the Programa Uruguay Audiovisual's 2022 national-production line, eligible executive-producer fees may not exceed 9% of the project's total eligible amount, and crew and cast fees must respect the Wage Council's Group 18 minimums.

value.base: total eligible amount of the project
